    Minimal injective resolutions over the standard mesh category #

    Every finite contravariant module over the standard mesh category has a two-step minimal injective presentation. In particular, each contravariant representable has a chosen exact complex Pₓ ⟶ I₀ ⟶ I₁ whose two injective maps are essential. These are the objects whose indecomposable summands are identified by the Bongartz--Gabriel socle and degree-one Ext arguments.
